map.溢价多少算正常？: How large a premium is normal?
map.热点城市溢价 20% 以上常见且偏热，超过 50% 需警惕面粉贵过面包，具体看周: Premiums above 20% are common in hot cities and signal an overheated market; above 50% watch for flour costing more than bread, judged against nearby sale prices.
